description.en: Sets the current match phase value read back by CMND_BTL_GET_MATCHPHASE — a general-purpose script-controlled phase counter distinct from CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_PHASE's half/duration setting.
True once the phase value has been set; null if no phase argument was given.

example.code:
// Advance the scripted match phase counter to 100
CMND_BTL_SET_MATCHPHASE(100);
